title: Global lake local-metric geometry and hydrological uncertainty follow-up
status: Freeze in git before new real-data geometry or fitting; retrospective follow-up to known results, not independent confirmation.
prior_exposure: Original global zeta=1.9295, iid interval [1.9185,1.9408], Country interval [1.5945,2.0296]; UK zeta=1.4413. Full source schema known; no new local-projection radii inspected before freeze.
source: Pinned HydroLAKES v1.0 polygons; all 1427688 features; DBF latin1; HydroBASINS standard level 3 v1.c all nine regions.
geometry: WGS84 ellipsoidal Lambert azimuthal equal area centred at each feature's first vertex; all clockwise exterior rings add, counterclockwise holes subtract. Moments about full-area centroid. Straight projected source segments; no geometry repair or selective omission.
sensitivity: Repeat all features with WGS84 geodesic azimuthal equidistant coordinates about same centre; also LAEA largest exterior ring. Each has its own radius-selected cohort.
reference_measure: Log-orthopolic territory allocation per d ln R; density alpha=zeta+1; territory prediction zeta=2.
basin_join: WGS84 Pour_long,Pour_lat point intersects closed basin polygon; boundary/overlap ties choose smallest HYBAS_ID. Unmatched ID=0; no nearest assignment. All lakes retained in global point/iid fit. Basin interval fits matched lakes only and reports coverage and its point/iid estimate.
block_rule: Resample K occupied level-3 basin IDs uniformly with replacement; keep every selected lake in each sampled basin, including multiplicities. Percentile 95% interval. Country resampling on the full selected cohort is a declared sensitivity.
decision: Matched-cohort exponent equivalence requires both iid and basin intervals wholly in [1.9,2.1]. Robust departure requires both intervals wholly below1.9 or both wholly above2.1; otherwise inconclusive. Global positive interpretation additionally requires100% basin coverage, no invalid selected topology, no selected maximum centre distance over200km, maximum selected |AEQD/LAEA radius-1|<=0.001, and nonrejection by descriptive iid bounded refitted KS (p>0.1). Failure of a geometry/coverage gate is qualification, not evidence against the exponent. Spatial independence remains an assumption.
diagnostics: Record selected polygon topological validity, full-source and selected max centre distance, LAEA/geodesic area ratio, AEQD/LAEA radius ratios, source Lake_area ratio, holes/components counts, cohort changes relative to original EPSG6933 and both alternatives. Original radii used only for comparisons after current fit choices frozen. Report Lake_type1 point estimate without describing it as verified natural lakes.
limitations: Prior outcome exposure; mapping completeness, radius selection and elongated lakes; heterogeneous mapping dates; basin dependence between blocks; coastal outlet mismatches; uniform area and local planar-distance approximation; exponent equivalence does not identify a resource allocation mechanism. A large-sample iid GOF rejection is not a spatially calibrated significance result.
basin_topology: Before outcomes,209/292 basins invalid in GEOS. Apply Shapely2.1.2 make_valid(linework) to basin overlay only; retain polygonal parts, require valid nonempty. Query equivalent outlet longitudes lambda and lambda+-360, deduplicate pairs. No lake geometry repair.
